name: bloogla-visual-editor
description: Builds admin/static/js/visual-editor.js (TipTap with Markdown) and copies KaTeX to admin/static/katex.

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --outfile=../static/js/visual-editor.body.js && node header.js && node katex.js
